title: Unified Synthesis of Compositional Speech and Sound from Free-Form Text Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2605.28063v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generating unified audio that naturally integrates speech and sounds from free-form text prompts remains challenging. For example, the prompt ``A fast drum roll ends with a cymbal crash, after which a man shouts: `Come on!'.'' describes several events that should appear in order and form a coherent recording rather than independent tracks that lack coherent temporal and semantic interactions. Current methods broadly follow two paradigms: pipeline methods couple separate text-to-sound and text-to-speech models, while unified models rely on a single generator that still requires structured, multi-field prompt inputs. translated_title: 从自由格式文本提示统一合成组合式语音与音效
translated_abstract: 从自由格式文本提示生成自然融合语音与音效的统一音频仍然极具挑战性。例如，提示语“一段快速的鼓点以镲片撞击声结束，随后一名男子大喊：‘加油！’”描述了多个应按顺序出现的事件，它们应构成一段连贯的录音，而不是缺乏时间与语义上连贯互动的独立音轨。当前的方法大致遵循两种范式：流水线方法将独立的文本到音效模型和文本到语音模型耦合在一起，而统一模型则依赖单一生成器，但仍需要结构化的多字段提示输入。这两种范式都需要上游的提示分解或改写，限制了自由格式的灵活性，并存在级联错误的风险。为了在单一模型内实现从自由格式提示的直接生成，我们提出了PlanAudio，这是一个端到端框架，可将无约束的自由格式文本直接映射为统一的音频，无需中间的提示分解步骤。
tldr: 提出PlanAudio端到端框架，无需提示分解或改写，即可将自由格式文本直接生成为语音与音效按序融合、时间与语义连贯的统一音频。
en_tdlr: PlanAudio is an end-to-end framework that directly maps unconstrained free-form text prompts into unified audio with coherently integrated, temporally ordered speech and sounds, eliminating the need for intermediate prompt decomposition or rewriting.
